document.name: Highbridge Voices — Summer Voices 2026
document.shortDescription: Two-week weekday summer music and arts camp in Highbridge with daily outside activities for students entering grades 3-12.
document.longDescription:
Highbridge Voices publishes a 2026 Summer Voices application for a two-week summer program running July 6 through July 17, 2026. The public form invites families to join for a fun and engaging program full of music, art, academics, and recreation, and lists offerings including strings, group piano, xylophone, recorder, Art Club, daily outside activities, and a field trip.

The same official application states the program runs Monday through Friday from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM and is open to students in grades 3 through 12. Highbridge Voices' Merriam campus page says the main campus is located in the heart of the Highbridge community and serves as the home base for its music and academic enrichment programs.

Published contact details on the official site list Highbridge Voices at 1360 Merriam Ave., Bronx, NY 10452, with phone (718) 293-8759 and email info@highbridgevoices.org. The public Summer Voices materials reviewed did not publish tuition, so ClassScout stores pricing as unknown.

Sources: https://www.highbridgevoices.org/summer2026/ https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeHloTPoMJ4UXeJ1kEzoQUX7sMYu3p2oFkXTQ9rgY9EzajGoQ/viewform?usp=publish-editor https://www.highbridgevoices.org/merriam/ https://www.highbridgevoices.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/061924_518-scaled.jpg
